bends.note: runs about due south from Warner to just below Parker, then turns SSW (about 11 deg) towards Emming and on to 231

ends.note: south end at a continuous lot line above the very steep hillside; the hillside lots fronting Emming lie across its foot
south end at the same continuous line above the very steep hillside; no street down to Emming

notes: Printed names without suffix (WARNER, GUY, CHICKASAW, ROHS, WHEELER, EMMING, PARKER) are written with 'Street'; W. CLIFTON AV. is 'West Clifton Avenue'. Guy runs down the left edge in the binding: only its east line is clear (x~342 at Warner, ~377 at Emming), so its centre is estimated from the water pipe and the 50' width (less certain, maybe +-20 px in x). Warner is 60' west of Wheeler and 40' east of it (north line steady, south line steps up at Wheeler), so the Wheeler/Warner point sits between the two centrelines (1701 west, 1643 east); Warner continues east past Clifton onto 242. Chickasaw, Rohs and Wheeler continue north across Warner onto 251/252; Clifton continues north onto 252/243. Wheeler and Guy end at Emming (Emming's south line continuous); Emming is 40' west of x~1630 and 50' east of it and ends at Clifton (Clifton's east line unbroken). Parker (~50', printed PARKER) comes in from the east (sheet 242) and ends at Clifton. The page is rotated slightly clockwise (vertical streets drift ~+30 px in x from top to bottom). Retaining-wall lines inside block 4 and the school building are not streets.
